title: Bulgaria wins Eurovision Song Contest, Israel comes second again
byline: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest for the first time on Saturday in a final overshadowed by five countries’ boycott over Gaza, claiming a dramatic victory despite another big public vote for Israel that again secured it second place.

title: Several spells of showers expected in parts of the island
byline: The low-pressure area located to the north of Sri Lanka is gradually weakening, according to the Department of Meteorology.

title: Over 5,200 affected by adverse weather conditions across Sri Lanka
byline: More than 5,200 individuals have been affected by the prevailing adverse weather conditions across Sri Lanka, according to the Disaster Management Centre (DMC).

title: Man drives car into pedestrians in Italy, injuring eight
byline: A man has driven his car into pedestrians in the northern Italian city of Modena, injuring eight people, four seriously, officials say.

title: IMF Executive Board to consider Sri Lanka’s combined reviews on May 27
byline: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has scheduled May 27, 2026 for its Executive Board to decide on the Fifth and Sixth reviews of Sri Lanka’s Extended Fund Facility (EFF) programme.

title: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in Congo, Uganda an emergency of international concern
byline: The World Health Organization on Sunday declared an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a ‘‘public health emergency of international concern."

title: Long-delayed police promotions to be expedited - Minister
byline: The Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs, Ananda Wijepala, says that long-overdue promotions for police officers, which had not been granted for over five years, are now being expedited.

title: Rainfall decreases across major river basins – Irrigation Dpt.
byline: The Department of Irrigation says a decrease in rainfall was observed yesterday (16) in areas surrounding the Kalu, Kelani, and Attanagalu Oya river basins.

title: Farmers warn of large-scale protests to Colombo over fertilizer crisis and falling paddy prices
byline: Farmers have warned the government that they will stage large-scale protest marches to Colombo if their legitimate demands are not addressed without delay.

title: Putin to visit Chinese leader Xi Jinping days after Trump’s trip to Beijing
byline: Russian President Vladimir Putin will meet with Chinese leader Xi Jinping on a two-day trip to Beijing next week, the Kremlin said Saturday.

title: Wanawasala train derailment: Police reveals removed railway track parts sold for Rs. 3,000
byline: Police have revealed that parts removed from the railway line where a train derailment occurred have been sold for Rs. 3,000, and the individual who purchased the items has also been arrested after his identity was traced, Western Province North Deputy Inspector General of Police Kalinga Jayasinghe said.

title: PM to hold talks on concerns of uni students occupying Malwana residence
byline: Prime Minister and Minister of Education, Higher Education and Vocational Education Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has turned her attention to a group of university students who have been forcibly occupying for several days a property located in Malwana and administered by the Dompe Divisional Secretariat.

title: 54-year-old found dead under suspicious circumstances in Mt. Lavinia
byline: Police have launched an investigation following a report received by the Mount Lavinia Police regarding a suspicious death inside a residence in the Badovita area of Mount Lavinia.

title: India, other oil importers to bilaterally negotiate transit corridors with Iran: Moody’s
byline: India and other oil importing nations are likely to negotiate bilaterally to secure energy supplies, potentially through coordinated transit corridors, but a return to pre-war traffic volumes is unlikely in 2026, Moody’s Ratings has said.

title: Two remanded over railway track component theft linked to Wanawasala derailment
byline: The individual suspected of removing sections of the railway line between Wanawasala and Kelaniya, along with the individual alleged to have purchased the removed railway materials, has been remanded in custody until May 29, authorities said.

title: Residents allege corruption in Monaragala disaster relief payments; officials accused of taking commissions
byline: Residents in several parts of Monaragala have accused several officials attached to the Monaragala Divisional Secretariat of allegedly engaging in fraudulent practices during the distribution of disaster compensation funds.

title: Popular hotel in Batticaloa sealed for two weeks after health violations
byline: A popular hotel in Batticaloa city has been sealed under an order issued by the Batticaloa Magistrate’s Court.

title: Election Commission urges public to verify 2026 voter registration details before upcoming enrollment process
byline: The Election Commission of Sri Lanka has issued a notice regarding registration for the 2026 electoral register.

title: Railway union calls for urgent restoration of night patrols following Wanawasala train derailment
byline: The Locomotive Operating Engineers’ Union has stated that the Railway Department’s night patrol services are currently not being properly carried out and has called for the immediate reinstatement of these services.

title: Sri Lanka backs Commonwealth cancer plan at Geneva health talks
byline: The Minister of Health and Mass Media, Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa has attended the Commonwealth Health Coordination Forum held in Geneva, Switzerland, on the sidelines of the 79th World Health Assembly.

title: Duo arrested with leopard skin, firearms, and ammunition in Wanathawilluwa
byline: Two individuals have been arrested by officers attached to the Department of Wildlife Conservation Wanathawilluwa sub-office for possessing a leopard skin, several firearms and ammunition inside a house located on a coconut estate.

title: Monaragala Disaster Relief Officer suspended over allegations of Ditwah compensation irregularities
byline: A Disaster Relief Services Officer in the Monaragala District, who is accused of irregularities in connection with Ditwah compensation payments, has been suspended from duty.

title: Govt. gazettes bill to abolish Chief of Defence Staff position and repeal 2009 Act
byline: A bill to repeal the Chief of Defence Staff Act No. 35 of 2009 has been published through an official gazette notification.

title: Two injured in collision involving NPP MP’s vehicle; Driver arrested
byline: A cab carrying National People’s Power (NPP) Galle District Member of Parliament T.K. Jayasundara was involved in a collision with a three-wheeler in Dunghena, Galle, police stated.

title: Tragedy at Victoria Reservoir: Two youths drown, one still missing
byline: Two youths have died after a group of four went swimming in the Victoria Reservoir near the Bambaragala Temple area in the Teldeniya Police Division.

title: Indian worker among four killed as Ukraine launches largest drone attack on Moscow in over a year
byline: Four people were killed in overnight Ukrainian drone strikes on Russia, authorities have said – in what appears to be the largest attack on Moscow in over a year.

title: Death toll in Victoria Reservoir tragedy increases to three
byline: The body of another individual missing after a group of four youths went to bathe in the Victoria Reservoir today (17), has been found.

title: Drone strike starts fire outside UAE nuclear plant
byline: A drone strike triggered a fire near a nuclear power station in the emirate of Abu Dhabi on Sunday (May 17), authorities said, reporting no injuries or impact on radiation levels.

title: Hanif Yusoof informs President of decision to step down as Western Province Governor
byline: The Governor of the Western Province, Hanif Yusoof says he has notified President Anura Kumara Dissanayake of his desire to resign from the post.

title: Sri Lanka, Belarus agree to expand bilateral ties
byline: The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, Vijitha Herath has concluded his official visit to the Republic of Belarus.

title: Muslims in Sri Lanka to celebrate Haj festival on May 28
byline: Muslims in Sri Lanka will celebrate the Haj festival (Eid al-Adha) on 28 May, the Colombo Grand Mosque has announced.

title: All document attestation services at Foreign Ministry Consular Division suspended
byline: All document attestation services at the Consular Affairs Division of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs have been temporarily suspended until further notice due to an unexpected technical failure of the Electronic Document Attestation System (e-DAS).

title: Stock markets fall in Middle East after US and Iran deal doubts
byline: Stock markets in the Middle East closed lower on Sunday after both US President Donald Trump and Iran’s Foreign Minister threw doubt on a deal to end the tension in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Benjamin Netanyahu speaks with Donald Trump about Iran war
byline: Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke with US President Donald Trump minutes ago about the war with Iran before convening a limited security discussion this evening, Netanyahu’s office confirms to The Times of Israel.

title: Two brothers drown in abandoned quarry in Kekirawa
byline: Two brothers drowned this afternoon (17) while swimming in an abandoned quarry in Samagigama, Kekirawa, police said.
